subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my note about running CPS web bookings for {Brand}, the way we did for Booking.com and GetYourGuide on top of their own site demand. The one point worth repeating: you pay per validated completed booking that carries a unique itinerary ID and revenue and survives your cancellation window, so the payout is already net of cancellations and no-shows. At scale that is around 3,500 validated bookings a day. Worth a short look at the route-level view?
illustrative_flags: 3,500 validated bookings a day (MobUpps-specific daily validated-booking volume; illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN travel_and_booking CPS: references prior outreach in first sentence (Booking.com/GetYourGuide); restates single proof (validated completed booking, itinerary ID + revenue, net of cancellations); one illustrative MobUpps figure (3,500 validated bookings/day); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native American-English; no sign-off; no X-not-Y; reused only parent-named brands.
